basic_details.job_title: HNBGU Project Assistant (Physics) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Physics, Hemvati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University (A Central University), Srinagar (Garhwal), has invited applications for a Project Assistant in the UCOST-sponsored project "From Particles to Precipitation: How Do Aerosols Shape Weather Patterns in Uttarakhand's Garhwal Himalaya". The post pays Rs. 15000/month for two years and requires M.Sc. in Physics with a minimum of 60% marks. Applications are sent by email to Dr. Alok Sagar Gautam latest by 11 November 2026, 05:00 PM.

how_to_apply: Fill the application proforma attached with the advertisement (page 2 of the notice). It asks for personal details, educational qualification from High School to M.Sc., M.Sc. thesis title, publications, address, contact number, email ID, other relevant information and a recent passport size photograph. Page 3 carries a declaration to be signed.
Prepare the Biodata/CV. It should clearly include contact details (address, mobile phone no., email ID), date of birth, qualifications, research experience and publication details (if any).
Prepare the three files in PDF format and name them: Your Name_Application_form.pdf, Your Name_CV.pdf and Your Name_Certificates.pdf.
Send the filled application with the CV and scanned copies of certificates by email to Dr. Alok Sagar Gautam at [email protected] and [email protected].
Write the email subject line as: Application for the Post of Project Assistant under UCOST Funded Project.
Send so that the email reaches latest by 11-11-2026, 05:00 PM.
Filled application proforma with a recent passport size photograph
Scanned mark sheets, degree certificate, experience certificate and valid identity proof, in PDF as a single compressed (zip/rar format) file
No Objection Certificate from the employer, for candidates who are already employed
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview in physical mode. Candidates who are already employed should produce an NOC from the employer. An application is liable to be cancelled if the information is found false or incorrect, or any ineligibility is detected before or after selection, as the declaration in the form states. Contact of the Principal Investigator: Dr. Alok Sagar Gautam, Department of Physics, Hemvati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University (A Central University), Srinagar – 246174, Dist. Garhwal (Uttarakhand), India; mobile +91 9997138763.

content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their merit and as per the requirement of the project. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the HNBGU Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The application email must reach latest by 11 November 2026, 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for the HNBGU Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The qualification is M.Sc. in Physics with a minimum of 60% Marks.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary of the HNBGU Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 15000/month.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for the HNBGU Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Email the filled application, CV and scanned certificates to [email protected] and [email protected], with the subject "Application for the Post of Project Assistant under UCOST Funded Project".

faq.question: Q5. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on merit and project requirement, followed by an interview tentatively in the 2nd week of November 2026 in online mode.

faq.question: Q6. Is the HNBGU Project Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary, and the appointment is for two years, matching the two-year project duration.

faq.question: Q7. How should the application files be named?
faq.answer: Send three PDF files named Your Name_Application_form.pdf, Your Name_CV.pdf and Your Name_Certificates.pdf.

faq.question: Q8. Is travel allowance paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview in physical mode.

faq.question: Q9. Do employed candidates need any certificate?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates who are already employed should produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the employer.

faq.question: Q10. Can the Project Assistant get Ph.D. admission?
faq.answer: The selected candidate may be considered for admission to the Ph.D. program as per institute eligibility, rules and statutes.
